messages:
alexa: Customer wants a short POC for BYO-HSM: offline key ceremony, 30d rotation, signed import receipts, and per-lookup SLA. Can we scope checklist + minimal SOW?
ravi: We can. Private connector supports PKCS#11 imports and will return attestation blobs when vendor supports it. Dual-control for rotation is typically customer-side but we can enforce a two-operator approval gate via our API before executing the rotation.
sarah: Compliance needs: signed import receipts, MAA/attestation, tamper photos, and SIEM forwarding. Also require DEK TTL <= 15m and immediate invalidation on rotation.
alexa: Latency ask: <=50-60ms p50 for key unwrap. They expect ~100M calls/month. How to keep HSM QPS manageable?
ravi: Recommend envelope encryption + short-lived DEKs cached on inference nodes. With DEK TTL=15m you'll reduce HSM ops drastically. If they insist on tighter TTL we can shorten and rely on proactive invalidation webhooks.
sarah: They also want geo-redundant HSMs (eu-west-1/us-east-1) and deterministic failover. We'll document options: deploy connectors in both regions and choose vendor-level sync mirroring for deterministic behavior.
alexa: Can someone drop a sample POC config and a 1-paragraph SOW blurb here I can send?
ravi: Sample config (replace placeholders):
```
external_kms:
  provider: customer_hsm
  connector: private-agent-v1
  pkcs11_module: /opt/hsm/lib/vendor_pkcs11.so
  key_alias: projects/customer/keys/llm-key
  rotation_days: "30"
  dek_ttl_seconds: "900"  # 15m
  allow_fallback: false
```
ravi: SOW blurb: "Redwood will deploy a Private connector to integrate the customer's HSM via PKCS#11, support an offline import ceremony, capture attestation blobs and signed import receipts, forward audit logs to the customer's SIEM, and provide rotation orchestration. Dual-control approval for rotation will be implemented as a two-operator approval step via the customer's chosen workflow. Fallback to Redwood-managed keys is allowed only with explicit customer authorization and is fully auditable."
sarah: I'll prepare a one-page POC checklist: network ports (outbound 443), mutual TLS cert exchange, test vectors for envelope encryption/unwrap, timeline (2 weeks) and acceptance criteria.
pricing-bot: Initial estimate posted: fixed onboarding fee + per-HSM-op fee. Will provide formal quote for 100M calls/mo after we pick DEK TTL assumptions.
alexa: Great, please attach checklist + pricing + attestation examples here when ready and I'll schedule the customer sync. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: private-agent-v1 scheduled for canary update tonight (no expected impact).
